text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their skills begins.
As for Eishin Flash—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we begin our training?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because I want to begin
training in thirty minutes.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, let's go see what they've got at the beach hut!
Time for some scouting♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
What did you come here for?
Well, I'll keep you company anyway♪
choice_data_list: ...Flash, why don't you get some rest too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I got plenty of sleep on the bus.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides, in the Japan Cup,
you'll be competing against formidable Senior-class rivals.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We'll be facing competitors ahead of schedule—
opponents we were never supposed to clash with at this stage...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "In that case, I believe you ought to push yourself to achieve a level beyond mere perfection."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...It's time to move out.
Shall we begin the summer training camp, then?"
